mapper.select:
SELECT p.member_id, p.plan_id, p.plan_name, g.greenhouse_name, c.crop_name, c.variety_name, p.plan_status, p.planned_start_date, p.planned_end_date, p.actual_start_date, p.actual_end_date FROM cultivation_plan AS p JOIN greenhouse AS g ON g.greenhouse_id = p.greenhouse_id JOIN crop_stage_standard AS s ON s.standard_id = p.standard_id JOIN crop AS c ON c.crop_id = s.crop_id WHERE p.member_id = #{memberId}
AND p.plan_name LIKE CONCAT('%', TRIM(#{planName}),'%')
AND g.greenhouse_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{greenhouseName},'%')
AND c.crop_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{cropName},'%')
AND c.variety_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{varietyName},'%')
AND p.plan_status LIKE CONCAT('%', #{planStatus},'%')
AND p.planned_end_date >= #{plannedStartDate}
AND #{plannedEndDate} >= p.planned_start_date
AND (p.actual_end_date >= #{actualStartDate} OR p.actual_end_date IS NULL)
AND #{actualEndDate} >= p.actual_start_date
ORDER BY p.plan_id DESC;

SELECT cp.plan_id, cp.plan_name, g.greenhouse_name, c.crop_name, c.variety_name, cp.planned_start_date, cp.planned_end_date, cp.actual_start_date, cp.actual_end_date, cp.plan_status, cp.end_reason, cp.created_at, cp.updated_at, cp.deleted_at FROM cultivation_plan AS cp JOIN greenhouse AS g ON g.greenhouse_id = cp.greenhouse_id JOIN crop_stage_standard AS css ON css.standard_id = cp.standard_id JOIN crop AS c ON c.crop_id = css.crop_id WHERE cp.member_id = #{memberId} AND cp.plan_id = #{planId} AND cp.deleted_at IS NULL;

SELECT cp.plan_id, cp.plan_name, g.greenhouse_name, c.crop_name, c.variety_name, cp.planned_start_date, cp.planned_end_date, cp.actual_start_date, cp.actual_end_date, cp.plan_status, cp.end_reason, cp.created_at, cp.updated_at, cp.deleted_at FROM cultivation_plan AS cp JOIN greenhouse AS g ON g.greenhouse_id = cp.greenhouse_id JOIN crop_stage_standard AS css ON css.standard_id = cp.standard_id JOIN crop AS c ON c.crop_id = css.crop_id WHERE cp.member_id = #{memberId} AND cp.plan_id = #{planId} AND cp.deleted_at IS NOT NULL;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cultivation_plan ( greenhouse_id, member_id, standard_id, plan_name, plan_status, planned_start_date, planned_end_date, created_at ) VALUES ( #{greenhouseId}, #{memberId}, #{standardId}, #{planName}, '미진행', #{plannedStartDate}, #{plannedEndDate}, NOW() )
mapper.update:
UPDATE cultivation_plan
plan_name = #{planName},
greenhouse_id = #{greenhouseId},
standard_id = #{standardId},
planned_start_date = #{plannedStartDate},
planned_end_date = #{plannedEndDate},
updated_at = NOW()
WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND plan_id = #{planId} AND plan_status = '미진행' AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE cultivation_plan SET actual_start_date = NOW(), plan_status = '진행', updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND plan_id = #{planId} AND plan_status = '미진행' AND actual_start_date IS NULL AND actual_end_date IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE cultivation_plan SET actual_end_date = NOW(), plan_status = '종료', end_reason = #{endReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND plan_id = #{planId} AND plan_status = '진행' AND actual_start_date IS NOT NULL AND actual_end_date IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE cultivation_plan SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND plan_id = #{planId} AND plan_status = '미진행'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cultivation_plan AS target JOIN cultivation_plan AS ongoing ON ongoing.greenhouse_id = target.greenhouse_id WHERE target.member_id = #{memberId} AND target.plan_id = #{planId} AND target.deleted_at IS NULL AND ongoing.plan_id != target.plan_id AND ongoing.plan_status = '진행' AND ongoing.deleted_at IS NULL )
